title: AppDescriptor
description: Describes a low-code app. Apps partition the model into independently named scopes: other descriptors reference their owning app through the `app` field, and the default app is implicit.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: create an app only when a group of entities, pages, forms, and scripts should be isolated under its own name. `name` is a lowercase kebab-case identifier such as `crm` or `field-service` and becomes part of runtime entity names (`<app>:<EntityName>`), app-scoped endpoint routes, and split descriptor file paths (`entities/<app>/...`). The reserved name `default` is the implicit app; descriptors without an `app` field belong to it. Set `isArchived` to hide an app without deleting its descriptors.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference used when this descriptor is stored as a model descriptor file.

name.description: Stable lowercase kebab-case app name, for example 'crm' or 'field-service'. Maximum 64 characters. 'default' is the implicit default app.

displayName.description: User-facing app title shown by the designer and admin console. Maximum 128 characters.

isArchived.description: When true, the app is archived and hidden from active app lists. Descriptors that belong to the app are kept.
